source.title: Recover stale Chrome debug bridge ownership across Codex sessions
source.objective: Prevent stale debug-bridge ownership from blocking later Grindr Web tasks. Detect whether the prior session owner is stale, then detach and rebind the correct tab idempotently while preserving the authenticated normal Chrome session and avoiding a Chrome restart.
source.acceptance_json: ["Bridge takeover detects and reports a stale prior owner before changing tab ownership.", "Detach and rebind are idempotent and attach the intended Grindr tab.", "The authenticated Chrome session and existing tabs remain open; Chrome is not restarted."]
